kind: Exploratory untimed nomination audit; no new simulations
rollout: No rollouts run; reused references had no-PAT static rollouts
reference_limitation: Old reference universe only; no evaluation of previously uncovered moves
pool_definition: Union of 25 base nominees, 25 by static + wide blocking adjustment, 25 by static + wide setup adjustment, and up to 5 exchange quota nominees within 35 static points. Base is either no-PAT static or PAT. Shared blocking/setup sources use the original checked universe. Counts remain adaptive.
raw_signal_extras: The earlier combined arm included additional top-five raw signals. They are excluded from BOTH pools in this literal three-source audit.
admission_validation: Reconstructed static+blocking admissions match all 1600 saved threat_wide pools; static+setup matches all 1200 saved setup_wide pools.
inference: Oracle potential using existing 60-second four-ply references, not selection performance or played-game strength. Maxima are noisy and the rare new winners were not independently validated.
coverage: Current model has six uncovered nominees across three general positions. HSP has five across two. None in targeted blocking sample.
additive_option: Keeping both static and PAT nominations avoids dropping static candidates but increases pool width; no selection sim was run on that additive pool.
